title: Named supplier record fails provenance with no replacement
scenario: The case names supplier record f10x1-supplier-status. Its only version is available with MIME application/json, but its metadata contentHash is the SHA-256 of different bytes (the same body with effectiveTo 2026-06-29), so the held body, which states an expired interval 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30, is unverified. No replacement record is supplied. Final encounter 2026-08-24, final order 2026-09-08 by SYN-PRAC-0001 and its receipt 2026-09-09T16:30:00Z are usable. Scope is supported.
syntheticProvenance: Original synthetic fixture written by hand (version decision oracle author, 2026-10-20). Every person, practitioner, supplier, identifier and clinical statement is fictional. No real patient record, Synthea output or copied policy, checklist or questionnaire text is included.
